findings.quote: Many moons are not plain rocky balls. Europa, a moon of Jupiter, has an icy shell over a rocky interior and is thought to hide a salty ocean under the ice.
findings.problem: Still open from rounds 1 to 3. This paragraph has five sentences, over the one-to-three limit. Others in this part also run over: 'The Solar System holds many kinds of objects' (4, the split added the fourth sentence), 'The giant planets are much larger' (4), 'A **natural satellite**, or moon' (4), 'A **comet** is a small body of ice' (4) and 'The gas and dust form a glowing cloud' (4). The sentences are short, so the harm is small.
